---
title: Collaboration & Community Building
tags: [Central themes, Collaboration & Community Building]
---

Supporting meaningful engagement and lasting collaboration, focusing on how we exchange knowledge effectively, learn from one another, and build sustainable, long-term partnerships across the DRI landscape.

**Includes resources that support:**

- Best practices for community building 
- Experiences, case studies and lessons learned 
- Knowledge exchange approaches and methods
- Guidance for the CAKE placements and visits to build long-lasting collaborations

## Resources 
<!-- material/tags {include: [Collaboration & Community Building]} -->

- [The Turing Way](https://book.the-turing-way.org/) - Handbook including guides for collaboration, communication and communities.
- [Community Champions Program Guides](https://www.cscce.org/resources/community-champions-programs/) - A set of resources for running community champion programs.
- [Effective Knowledge Exchange](https://www.ukri.org/councils/esrc/impact-toolkit-for-economic-and-social-sciences/how-to-do-effective-knowledge-exchange/) - UKRI website about knowledge exchange.
- [KE Panel at the SSI Research Software Camp](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i_WHlRFKbwc) - Panel discussion on Knowledge Exchange.
- [RCM Cooperative - Building Sustainable Research Communities](https://www.rcmcooperative.com/)
